Paul in the storm, Acts 27. The ship broke apart, the crew fear, the prisoner spoke faith, and God had promised life to those with Paul, and they all reached the shore, cold and wet, but alive. A bad night is not the end of God's promise. If you feel shipwrecked, hold the Word He gave you, help others if you can, and believe He can bring you to a shore, even a strange one, with a next step to serve Him.
